title: The Moon Has 181 Giant Craters
fact: The Moon has at least 181 giant craters over 12 miles wide. The largest is the South Pole-Aitken basin, 1,600 miles across.

title: Your Lungs Have 300 Million Alveoli
fact: Your lungs contain about 300 million tiny air sacs called alveoli. If spread flat, they'd cover about 70 square meters.

title: The Amazon Has 2.5 Million Insect Species
fact: Scientists estimate the Amazon rainforest contains about 2.5 million insect species, though many remain undiscovered.

title: A Group of Hippos Is Called a Bloat
fact: A group of hippos is called a bloat. Despite their cute appearance, hippos are among Africa's most dangerous animals.

title: Blockchain Can Process 100,000 Transactions Per Second
fact: Some blockchain networks can process over 100,000 transactions per second, though most process far fewer. This depends on network architecture.

title: Forests Support 80% of Land Biodiversity
fact: Forests are home to about 80% of terrestrial animal and plant species, making them crucial for global biodiversity conservation.

title: The Declaration of the Rights of Man Was in 1789
fact: The Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen, adopted in 1789, established principles of liberty, equality, and popular sovereignty in France.

title: A Group of Finches Is Called a Charm
fact: A group of finches is called a charm. Darwin's finches from the Galapagos Islands helped shape his theory of evolution.

title: The Moon's Gravity Creates Earth's Tides
fact: The Moon's gravitational pull creates Earth's ocean tides. The Sun also contributes to tides, but the Moon has twice the effect.

title: Your Stomach Acid Can Dissolve Some Metals
fact: Gastric acid (stomach acid) has a pH of 1-2, strong enough to dissolve some metals. It kills bacteria in food and aids digestion.

title: Mount Everest Gains 4mm in Height Annually
fact: Mount Everest grows approximately 4 millimeters per year due to the ongoing collision between the Indian and Asian tectonic plates.

title: A Group of Shrimp Is Called an Army
fact: A group of shrimp is called an army. Mantis shrimp have the most complex eyes in the animal kingdom, with 16 color receptors.

title: The Term 'Bug' Was First Used in 1947
fact: The term 'computer bug' was first used in 1947 when Grace Hopper found a moth stuck in the Harvard Mark II computer.

title: Forests Reduce Hospital Visits
fact: Studies show that living near forests and green spaces reduces the number of hospital visits and improves recovery rates.

title: The First Written Language Was Sumerian Cuneiform
fact: Sumerian cuneiform, developed around 3400 BCE in Mesopotamia, is considered the first written language in human history.

title: A Group of Raccoons Is Called a Gaze
fact: A group of raccoons is called a gaze. Raccoons can rotate their paws 180 degrees to manipulate objects with great dexterity.

title: There Are More Trees on Earth Than Stars in the Milky Way
fact: Scientists estimate there are about 3 trillion trees on Earth, while the Milky Way has only 100-400 billion stars.

title: Your Brain Generates 20 Watts of Electricity
fact: Your brain generates about 20 watts of electricity—enough to power a small light bulb—through the electrical activity of neurons.

title: The Amazon River Is Wider Than the Next 10 Rivers Combined
fact: The Amazon River's width varies from 1 to 30 miles, making it wider than the next 10 largest rivers combined at their mouths.

title: A Group of Crabs Is Called a Cast
fact: A group of crabs is called a cast. Fiddler crabs can regenerate lost limbs, including their large cheliped claw.

title: The First Pixel Was Displayed in 1957
fact: Russell Kirsch created the first digital image in 1957: a 176x176 pixel picture of his son. Each pixel was a simple square.

title: Trees Can Detect Chemical Signals From Damaged Neighbors
fact: Trees can detect chemical signals released by damaged or attacked neighboring trees, triggering their own defense mechanisms.

title: The Gutenberg Press Could Produce 3,600 Pages Per Day
fact: Johannes Gutenberg's printing press, invented around 1440, could produce about 3,600 pages per day compared to 40 by hand.

title: A Group of Ferrets Is Called a Business
fact: A group of ferrets is called a business. Ferrets have been domesticated for over 2,000 years for hunting rabbits.

title: The Moon Orbits Earth at 2,288 mph
fact: The Moon orbits Earth at about 2,288 miles per hour, completing one orbit every 27.3 days. This is why the Moon always shows the same face to Earth.

title: Your Body Has 37.2 Trillion Cells
fact: The human body contains approximately 37.2 trillion cells, constantly being replaced. Red blood cells live about 120 days.

title: The Sahara Desert Has Sand Dunes Over 1,000 Feet High
fact: Some sand dunes in the Sahara Desert reach heights of over 1,000 feet (300 meters). The tallest recorded dune is about 1,287 feet high.

title: A Group of Monkeys Is Called a Troop
fact: A group of monkeys is called a troop. Spider monkeys have prehensile tails that can support their entire body weight.

title: The First Mobile Phone Call Was Made in 1973
fact: Martin Cooper of Motorola made the first mobile phone call on April 3, 1973, to his rival at Bell Labs.

title: Trees Can Reduce Noise Pollution by 50%
fact: A 100-foot-wide belt of trees can reduce noise by 50%, absorbing and blocking sound waves. This is why forests feel peaceful.

title: The Rosetta Stone Was Created in 196 BCE
fact: The Rosetta Stone, created in 196 BCE, bears the same text in three scripts and was key to deciphering Egyptian hieroglyphs.

title: A Group of Cranes Is Called a Herd
fact: A group of cranes is called a herd or sedge. Whooping cranes are among the tallest flying birds in North America.

title: The Moon Has 181 Known 'Maria' (Seas)
fact: The Moon has 181 known maria (dark plains), formed by ancient volcanic eruptions. The largest is Mare Imbrium.

title: Your Small Intestine Is 22 Feet Long
fact: The small intestine is about 22 feet long and 1 inch in diameter. Its surface area is about 2,700 square feet due to villi.

title: Lake Baikal Is the Deepest and Oldest Lake
fact: Lake Baikal in Siberia is the world's deepest lake at 1,642 meters and oldest at 25-30 million years. It contains 20% of Earth's fresh water.

title: A Group of Rabbits Is Called a Fluffle
fact: A group of rabbits is called a fluffle. Rabbits can rotate their ears 180 degrees to locate sounds from any direction.

title: The First Commercial Email Was Sent in 1978
fact: The first commercial spam email was sent in 1978 by Digital Equipment Corporation to 400 ARPANET users, advertising their new computers.

title: Trees Can Absorb 100 Gallons of Water Daily
fact: A large tree can absorb and transpire up to 100 gallons of water daily, helping regulate local humidity and rainfall patterns.

title: The Silk Road Was 4,000 Miles Long
fact: The ancient Silk Road stretched about 4,000 miles, connecting China to the Mediterranean through Central Asia.

title: A Group of Frogs Is Called an Army
fact: A group of frogs is called an army. Some frog species can freeze solid in winter and thaw out alive in spring.

title: Jupiter's Great Red Spot Is a Storm Larger Than Earth
fact: Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a storm larger than Earth, with winds up to 400 mph. It has been raging for at least 400 years.

title: Your Bladder Can Hold 400-600ml of Urine
fact: The average adult bladder can hold about 400-600ml (about 2 cups) of urine. Signals about fullness reach the brain at about 200ml.

title: The Amazon Has 2.5 Million Insect Species
fact: The Amazon rainforest contains approximately 2.5 million insect species, with many more yet to be discovered by scientists.

title: A Group of Toads Is Called a Knot
fact: A group of toads is called a knot. Unlike frogs, toads have dry, warty skin and spend more time on land.

title: The First Computer Mouse Was Made of Wood
fact: Douglas Engelbart's first computer mouse (1964) was made of wood with two perpendicular wheels. Commercial versions appeared in 1984.

title: Trees Store Carbon for Hundreds of Years
fact: Forests store carbon in their biomass and soil for hundreds to thousands of years, helping mitigate climate change.

title: The Great Wall of China Is 13,171 Miles Long
fact: The Great Wall of China stretches about 13,171 miles when all sections are measured, though only about 15% remains intact.

title: A Group of Quail Is Called a Covey
fact: A group of quail is called a covey. Quail are known for their distinctive head plumes and are popular game birds.

title: Saturn's rings Are 90% Water Ice
fact: Saturn's rings are composed of about 90% water ice, with particles ranging from tiny grains to boulders the size of houses.

title: Your Kidneys Filter 120-150 Quarts of Blood Daily
fact: Your kidneys filter about 120-150 quarts of blood daily, producing 1-2 quarts of urine. They balance fluids and remove waste.

title: The Mariana Trench Is 36,070 Feet Deep
fact: The Mariana Trench reaches 36,070 feet at its deepest point. The pressure there is over 1,000 times atmospheric pressure.

title: A Group of Rooks Is Called a Parliament
fact: A group of rooks is called a parliament. Rooks are intelligent birds known for their ability to solve complex problems.

title: The First Webcam Was Created to Monitor Coffee Pot
fact: The first webcam was created at Cambridge University in 1991 to monitor a coffee pot so researchers knew if coffee was ready.

title: Trees Absorb More CO2 Than They Emit
fact: Forests absorb more carbon dioxide than they emit, making them net carbon sinks essential for climate regulation.

title: The Library of Alexandria Was Founded in 283 BCE
fact: The Library of Alexandria, founded in 283 BCE, was one of the largest libraries of the ancient world, holding hundreds of thousands of scrolls.

title: A Group of Starlings Is Called a Murmuration
fact: A group of starlings is called a murmuration. These large groups create mesmerizing coordinated flight patterns.

title: The Sun Is 4.6 Billion Years Old
fact: The Sun formed about 4.6 billion years ago from a giant cloud of gas and dust. It will continue burning for another 5 billion years.

title: Your Tongue Has 8,000 Taste Buds
fact: The tongue has about 8,000 taste buds, each containing 50-100 receptor cells. Taste buds are replaced every 1-2 weeks.

title: The Sahara Desert Is 3.6 Million Square Miles
fact: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world at 3.6 million square miles, roughly the size of the United States.

title: A Group of Storks Is Called a Muster
fact: A group of storks is called a muster. Storks are known for their long-distance migrations and deliver mythology.

title: The First Smartphone Was the IBM Simon in 1994
fact: The IBM Simon Personal Communicator, released in 1994, is considered the first smartphone with email, calendar, and touchscreen.

title: Trees Help Regulate the Water Cycle
fact: Trees absorb water through roots and release it through leaves in a process called transpiration, regulating local and global water cycles.

title: The Colosseum Could Hold 50,000-80,000 Spectators
fact: The Roman Colosseum could hold between 50,000-80,000 spectators who gathered to watch gladiatorial contests and public spectacles.

title: A Group of Vultures Is Called a Wake
fact: A group of vultures is called a wake. These birds play an important ecological role as nature's cleanup crew.

title: The Moon Is Slowly Moving Away From Earth
fact: The Moon recedes from Earth at about 3.8 cm per year. In 600 million years, total solar eclipses will no longer occur.

title: Your Hair Grows 6 Inches Per Year
fact: Hair grows about 0.3-0.4 mm per day, or 6 inches per year. Growth is faster in summer than winter and during sleep.

title: Lake Superior Contains 10% of World's Freshwater
fact: Lake Superior contains about 10% of all surface fresh water on Earth, holding more water than all other Great Lakes combined.

title: A Group of Walruses Is Called a Pod
fact: A group of walruses is called a pod. Walrus tusks can grow up to 3 feet long and are used for climbing onto ice.

title: The First Computer Virus Was Called 'Creeper' in 1971
fact: The Creeper virus, created by Bob Thomas in 1971, was the first computer virus. It displayed 'I'm the Creeper: Catch me if you can!'

title: Trees Provide 1.6 Billion People With Livelihoods
fact: About 1.6 billion people globally depend on forests for their livelihoods, including food, medicine, fuel, and income.

title: The Trojan War Occurred Around 1200 BCE
fact: The Trojan War, described in Homer's Iliad, is believed to have occurred around 1200 BCE. Archaeological evidence confirms Troy existed.

title: A Group of Wildebeest Is Called a Cracker
fact: A group of wildebeest is called a cracker. Each year, 1.5 million wildebeest migrate across the Serengeti in Earth's greatest wildlife spectacle.

title: The Milky Way Will Merge With Andromeda
fact: The Milky Way and Andromeda are approaching each other at 250,000 mph and will merge in about 4.5 billion years.

title: Your Bones Are Stronger Than Steel
fact: Bone is stronger than steel gram for gram. A matchbox-sized block of bone could support 10 tons of weight.

title: The Amazon River Has No Permanent Bridges
fact: The Amazon River, despite being over 4,000 miles long, has no permanent bridges. The river's width makes bridging impractical.

title: A Group of Zebras Is Called a Dazzle
fact: A group of zebras is called a dazzle. Their stripes are unique to each individual, like human fingerprints.

title: WiFi Was Invented in Australia in the 1990s
fact: WiFi technology was developed by CSIRO in Australia in the 1990s. The term 'WiFi' doesn't stand for anything—it's a trademark.

title: Trees Are Home to 80% of Land Species
fact: Forests are home to about 80% of terrestrial biodiversity, including 80% of amphibians, 75% of birds, and 65% of mammals.

title: The French Revolution Began in 1789
fact: The French Revolution began on July 14, 1789, with the storming of the Bastille, transforming France from monarchy to republic.

title: A Group of Buffalo Is Called an Obstinacy
fact: A group of buffalo is called an obstinacy. American bison can run up to 35 mph despite weighing up to 2,000 pounds.

title: Venus Spins Backwards Compared to Other Planets
fact: Venus rotates clockwise (retrograde) while most planets rotate counterclockwise. A day on Venus is longer than its year.

title: Your Brain Uses 20% of Your Energy
fact: Despite being only 2% of body weight, your brain uses about 20% of your energy. This makes it vulnerable to low blood sugar.

title: The Dead Sea Is 430 Meters Below Sea Level
fact: The Dead Sea's shoreline is the lowest exposed point on Earth at 430.5 meters below sea level. It's also one of the saltiest bodies of water.

title: A Group of Bats Is Called a Colony
fact: A group of bats is called a colony or cauldron. Bats are the only mammals capable of sustained flight.

title: Python Was Named After Monty Python
fact: Guido van Rossum named Python after Monty Python, not the snake. He was reading their scripts when developing the language.

title: Trees Can Live for Thousands of Years
fact: Bristlecone pines can live over 5,000 years, making them the longest-lived organisms on Earth. Some clonal colonies are even older.

title: The Magna Carta Was Signed in 1215
fact: The Magna Carta was signed by King John of England in 1215, establishing that everyone, including the king, was subject to the law.

title: A Group of Iguanas Is Called a Massacre
fact: A group of iguanas is called a massacre. Marine iguanas from the Galapagos are the only seagoing lizards on Earth.

title: Mars Has the Tallest Mountain in the Solar System
fact: Olympus Mons on Mars is 72,000 feet tall, nearly three times Mount Everest's height. It's a shield volcano billions of years old.

title: Your Brain Has 86 Billion Neurons
fact: The human brain contains about 86 billion neurons, each connected to thousands of others via synapses, creating about 100 trillion connections.

title: Russia Spans 11 Time Zones
fact: Russia spans 11 time zones, the most of any country. When it's morning in Kaliningrad, it's already evening in Kamchatka.

title: A Group of Jellyfish Is Called a Smack
fact: A group of jellyfish is called a smack. Jellyfish have been floating in Earth's oceans for over 500 million years.

title: JavaScript Was Created in Just 10 Days
fact: Brendan Eich created JavaScript in 10 days in 1995. Originally called LiveScript, it was renamed JavaScript to capitalize on Java's popularity.

title: Trees Cover 31% of Earth's Land
fact: Forests cover about 31% of Earth's total land area, totaling 4.06 billion hectares. They provide habitat for 80% of biodiversity.

title: The Renaissance Began in 14th Century Italy
fact: The Renaissance began in Florence, Italy around 1350, spreading throughout Europe and marking a rebirth of art, science, and learning.

title: A Group of Ravens Is Called an Unkindness
fact: A group of ravens is called an unkindness. Ravens are among the most intelligent birds and can solve complex problems.

title: The Universe Has No Center
fact: The universe has no center because it is expanding uniformly in all directions from every point. There is no special location from which to measure expansion.

title: Your Nose Makes 1 Liter of Mucus Daily
fact: You produce about 1-1.5 liters of nasal mucus per day. Most of it gets swallowed unconsciously, which is completely normal.

title: The Amazon Rainforest Is 5.5 Million km²
fact: The Amazon rainforest covers about 5.5 million square kilometers, spanning nine countries. It is the largest tropical rainforest in the world.

title: A Group of Leopards Is Called a Leap
fact: A group of leopards is called a leap. Leopards are the most widespread of all big cats, found across Africa and Asia.
